relevant_data:
1 compartment: Biota (Biota, Aquatic)

14 biota samples. Species (9): Pandalus borealis, Eukronia hamata, Calanus hyperboreus, Calanus finmarchicus, Metridia longa, Euchaeta norvegica, Themisto abyssorum, Meganyctiphanes norvegica, Sabinea sarsi. Tissue types: Whole body. Life stages: Not reported. Genders: Not reported

4 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Plankton net sampling: (Zooplankton samples taken with vertically towed 'Helgoländer Planktonnetz' (mesh size 500 µm, diameter 1 m), hauled at 0.7 m sec-1 from depths of 200-460 m. Animals kept alive in sea water for 1-3 h to allow defecation.)
Sampling Protocol - Trawl sampling: (Decapod samples from GOV (Chalut à Grande Ouverture Verticale) trawl from depths of 170-330 m, trawling time 30 min at 4 knots.)
Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (Freeze-dried samples homogenised using boron carbide mortar and pestle or agate ball mill. ~10 mg dried material digested for 3 h at 80°C with 100 µl HNO3 (65%, suprapure, Merck) in tightly closed 2-ml Eppendorf tubes. Digests made up to 2 ml with double distilled water.)
Extraction Protocol - Acid digestion: (Freeze-dried samples homogenised using boron carbide mortar and pestle or agate ball mill. ~10 mg dried material digested for 3 h at 80°C with 100 µl HNO3 (65%, suprapure, Merck) in tightly closed 2-ml Eppendorf tubes. Digests made up to 2 ml with double distilled water.)
limitations: Paper identifies biota to species level, although how confident we can be in their identification is unclear.
